Hannah (Eng PM): Heads up team 96 I finished the postmortem draft for the 04/03 rate-limiting storm: https://go/redwood/postmortem/1923. Need to lock down external comms and the customer RCAs policy.

Luis (SRE): Root cause summary: autoscaler config combined with bursty cold-starts caused control-plane throttling; our fallback introduced synthetic 429s. We're fairly confident no data loss.

Priya (Support): From the support queue, customers want: (a) a clear short status update we can reference, (b) a one-page writeup for customers who open tickets, (c) for large customers, the option of a tech call.

Oliver (Product): For statuspage: very short, non-technical. For the customer one-pager: include timeline, impact, mitigations, and next steps. For calls: agree to offer for enterprise partners only.

Nora (Legal): Reminder: avoid operational language that could be read as admitting "we didn't have capacity". We can offer redacted RCAs and an on-record call. Full internal logs only with NDA/contract and Legal sign-off.

Luis (SRE): Proposed artifacts: statuspage blurb, customer summary (non-sensitive), internal RCA with logs+playbook (internal only). I'll flag internal sections that must be redacted.

Hannah (Eng PM): Let's set owners and SLAs. ACTION-1: Priya to post statuspage update and provide canned reply for Support within 3 hours (1923459012).

Priya (Support): ACK. Drafting now: ```Status update: We experienced intermittent API rate limiting affecting some requests between 02:05902:23 UTC due to an autoscaler configuration issue. Mitigations applied; normal service resumed. We are investigating and will publish a post-incident summary.```

Luis (SRE): Change "intermittent" to "brief" and add "no customer data lost" if confirmed.

Hannah (Eng PM): Confirmed, no data loss. Priya, please add that sentence.

Priya (Support): Updated draft: ```Status update: We experienced a brief period of elevated rate limiting between 02:05902:23 UTC caused by an autoscaler configuration issue. Mitigations were applied and service has returned to normal. No customer data was lost. A post-incident summary will be published.```

Oliver (Product): LGTM. Add a pointer for enterprise SLA contacts (helps reduce inbound).

Nora (Legal): Language is okay. For sharing docs: policy as discussed in the legal playbook: redacted timeline + remediation to be provided on request; full internal RCA only provided under a mutual NDA or as part of enterprise support agreements. I will draft a short template reply.

Hannah (Eng PM): ACTION-2: Luis to produce the internal RCA draft and mark redaction points. ETA 48 hours (1923536412).

Luis (SRE): Will do. I'll include sequence diagrams and a clear timeline.

Hannah (Eng PM): ACTION-3: Oliver to coordinate with Customer Success on enterprise call offers and to draft an invite template. ETA 5 business days (1923865212).

Oliver (Product): On it. I'll prepare a short FAQ + invite template.

Hannah (Eng PM): ACTION-4: Nora to prepare legal redaction checklist + quick-approval flow for Support requests. ETA 72 hours (1923600012).

Nora (Legal): I'll put together the checklist and an approval ping path (Solutions -> Legal).

Luis (SRE): Also noting pattern: this is the second autoscaler-related incident in 8 months. Recommend a tactical fix (hardening config) + strategic project (rewrite of autoscaler client). ACTION-5: I'll create an engineering RFC and cost estimate. Owner: Luis. ETA 2 weeks (1924072412).

Priya (Support): Quick ops question: for customers requesting the postmortem, do we offer a single PDF or a staged release (redacted then more detail after NDA)?

Nora (Legal): Staged release. Initial redacted summary + remediation. Full internal materials only after Legal review and contractual agreement.

IncidentBot: Created incident actions: INC-1923-A1 (Priya) INC-1923-A2 (Luis) INC-1923-A3 (Oliver) INC-1923-A4 (Nora) INC-1923-A5 (Luis). Track at https://go/redwood/incidents/1923/actions

Priya (Support): Posting statuspage now and will push canned reply to Support playbook. Will update when done.

Luis (SRE): One operational note for the customer summary: avoid mentioning internal endpoint names or internal region codes; we'll sanitize diagrams.

Oliver (Product): For enterprise calls, recommend we offer a brief walk-through + follow-up email with the redacted summary. Keep calls to 30 minutes.

Hannah (Eng PM): All right. To recap: public statuspage posted now; customer one-page summary in 48h; internal RCA in 48h (internal only) with redaction markers; redacted doc available to customers on request after Legal review; full raw logs only under NDA/contract. If no objections, I'll close decisions and track these as actions.

Priya (Support): Statuspage posted and canned reply sent. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1923 (1923454120)

Nora (Legal): No objections.

Luis (SRE): No objections.

Oliver (Product): No objections.

Hannah (Eng PM): Closing this thread. We'll follow up on action items in the incident board. :white_check_mark:
